annotations.title: An app's goal, limits and agent memory

description: Use this when the user asks what goal, markets, constraints or limits Apptiller works from for an app. What Apptiller's agent works from for one app: the brief the user set (the goal, such as a target cost per paying subscriber or a ROAS, core countries, competitors, constraints such as "don't touch brand campaigns", and short facts), the limits it works inside (mode: watch only reports, ask proposes and waits for approval; the biggest step one change may take; the most a day's budget may grow; which levers it may use; campaigns it must never touch), its open plan items with their check dates, its last 14 journal entries and what past changes taught it on this app. Read-only.
name: app_brief
title: An app's goal, limits and agent memory
